# Cryp-Cross

> Cryp-Cross is a free daily cryptographic crossword. Each day everyone gets the same generated grid, and every clue is encrypted with that day's classical cipher: a Caesar shift, Atbash, or Vigenere (whose keyword is the answer to a plain-text key clue). Players decode the clues with a built-in decoder, fill the grid, and with a free account can check answers, submit timed solves, keep streaks and appear on the daily leaderboard.
